judgments.reason: The whole srog gcod pa has exact take the life evidence. Its verbal component means cutting; English take belongs to the whole idiom. Independent gcod pa master evidence does not establish take. Retain srog/life.
Ni marks topic/focus, not an independent lexical copula. The definition supplies is to / is that which is; a selected is alone asserts a narrower correspondence than source syntax establishes.

Whole mi snyan pa/unpleasant is confirmed by the current quote and complete repeated quotations. Mi/un is a declared approved negative subword. Snyan pa/pleasant has only reference-dictionary support (the HGM lexical entry gives good), and the interior positive English stem is outside the explicit four-negative-affix exception in the written brief. Generator d7 substring exemption is mechanical, not semantic permission.

Gang/what and zhe na/ask separate the question content from the formula. Whole zhes byung ba/says is an actual quotation formula at d3; phyir/as introduces attribution. The root text itself, feel, articles and de dag expansion remain unwrapped.

Full nang and nang gi entries both attest within. The lexical inner/interior relation has a recoverable English within exponent in this noun phrase, allowing the tighter nang. Omitting adjacent gi does not declare its relation absent.

The whole idiom is attested, but lexical force and intact instrumental gis/by are independently localizable. Of ones belongs to the larger causal possessive frame; no torn agentive s or manufactured child.

One English occur explicitly governs both alternative causes. Choosing the first Tibetan predicate represents it once; the second stays omitted as shared, not absent or unexpressed. This is different from342 MED, whose negative content is never stated.

In the form of explains enjoyment as physical sensations, while possession of certain enjoyments expands de la anaphorically. Neither proposed one-word case alignment is sufficiently independent of those larger recasts. No null is licensed.

judgments.topic: bsdus pa/part of versus kyis/of + part
judgments.reason: Full bsdus pa attests both part and part of; English of is governed by part in this nominal recast of Tibetan inclusion. Assigning it independently to kyis overstates locality. Omit kyis without denying its relation.

The positive dge is a transparent lexical member and virtues is a complete hyphen-delimited English member, strictly inside the parent. It differs from pleasant cut within an unhyphenated word. No separate non- affix claim is added.

The source explicitly denies existence of both virtue and nonvirtue. English a view about those objects does not express that predicate; non- renders mi dge, not med. The entire negative existential has no explicit English exponent, irrespective of possible intentional abbreviation.

The absence is concrete and source-internal. Contextual object-focused abbreviation remains credible and forbids a confident defect or restoration claim. C05:357/362 and C16 repeats clarify the doctrine but are not a corrected same-passage witness. E-120 is an omission analogy, not correction authority. Preserve the English proposal question at LOW/UNCERTAIN only.

Third and last are licensed by the four-way enumeration; names/forms and repeated gzhi/yin have distinct actual occurrences. Whole sogs/and so forth closes the list; brten/based and la/on are localized. Nas/ultimately, par/about and the numbered following heading remain omitted.
